### 1. Structure

**Hash Table = Array + Hash Function + Collision Resolution**

- [Storage Structure & Stored Data](nodal://note/quiz7-hash-tables/sec-array-entry)；[Collision Resolution](nodal://note/quiz7-hash-tables/sec-collision-notes)
- **Hash Table**：具体 Data Structure，可实现 [Dictionary / Map 等 ADT](nodal://note/data-structures-adt/sec-adt-definition)，也可用于 Key-only Collection
- **Hash Function → Initial Index**；**Collision Resolution + Table State → Final Storage Location**
